subject: POC Trial: RACI and Next Steps for Aurora Health
messages:
From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: Paula Ramirez <paula.ramirez@aurorahealth.com>, Tom Erickson <terickson@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed POC plan (success criteria, timelines, ownership)

Hi Paula / Tom -

Great to meet earlier. Thanks for walking us through Aurora's goals for a small, low-latency clinical triage assistant. Per our call, I wanted to capture the proposed POC scope, success criteria, timeline, and who we think should own which pieces so we can align on next steps.

POC scope (2 weeks):
- Ingest a representative subset of triage prompts (approx 200) + 3 anonymized sample records
- Deploy Redwood-hosted trial model behind Aurora VPC peering (private test env)
- Evaluate accuracy of triage suggestions, response latency, and integration ease with your triage UI

Success criteria (pass/fail thresholds):
- Precision on triage suggestions >= 85% against your evaluation set
- 95th percentile latency < 600ms for 512-token prompts
- Integration: endpoint wired into UI sandbox with <3 engineering-days of integration effort

Timeline (target):
- Week 0 (this week): Align RACI, data access, and procurement contact
- Week 1: Redwood SE (Aditya) stands up trial environment; Aurora provides sample data and API endpoint
- Week 2: Run evaluation, collect metrics, demo results, and decide next steps

Proposed RACI (owner = R, accountable = A, consulted = C, informed = I):
- Infra/network (VPC peering, firewall rules): R=Tom Erickson (Aurora), C=Aditya Rao (Redwood SE)
- App integration (triage UI wiring): R=Paula Ramirez (Aurora product), C=Marissa Cole (Redwood AE)
- Security & compliance (data handling, evidence): R=IT Security (Aurora), C=Redwood Security (we'll surface SOC2 docs)
- Procurement/contract: R=Paula / Aurora procurement, C=Marissa
- Trial setup & telemetry: R=Aditya Rao (Redwood SE), A=Marissa Cole

Open items / asks from Aurora:
1) Confirm infra owner for peering and a preferred contact (we think that's Tom).
2) Point us at the sample data set (anonymized) and any data handling constraints.
3) Provide procurement contact if we need an MSA/PO for the trial.
4) Flag any security questionnaire items required up front (we can provide SOC2 and a short runbook).

Attachments: aurora_poc_ma_schedule.xlsx (draft milestone schedule) and aurora_security_questionnaire.pdf (your questionnaire we received earlier).

Next steps: If you confirm owners and procurement contact today, Aditya will schedule the SE preflight for Tuesday and we can target a trial start on Thursday.

Thanks -

Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Paula Ramirez <paula.ramirez@aurorahealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tom Erickson <terickson@aurorahealth.com>, IT Security <it-security@aurorahealth.com>, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed POC plan (success criteria, timelines, ownership)

Thanks Lauren - this is great and aligns with our internal thinking. Couple quick answers and a couple asks: 

1) Infra owner: confirmed - Tom will own VPC peering and firewall changes. Tom, I'll loop you in for the preflight.
2) Sample data: I'll share an anonymized set (200 prompts + 3 records) by EOD tomorrow. Note: PHI is off-limits, everything will be de-identified.
3) Procurement: Our procurement lead is Julia Nguyen (julia.nguyen@aurorahealth.com). She handles short trials/POs.
4) Security: Our InfoSec team would like to see Redwood's SOC2 and a short description of where customer data is processed. We'll start with the questionnaire we sent earlier (attached).

One ask: can Redwood confirm where telemetry/metrics from the trial will be stored and whether logs contain any PII? We prefer logs to be retained in our VPC if possible.

If that works, we'll aim to kick off this Thursday.

- Paula
Paula Ramirez
Senior Product Manager, Clinical Automation
Aurora Health
paula.ramirez@aurorahealth.com
From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: Paula Ramirez <paula.ramirez@aurorahealth.com>, Tom Erickson <terickson@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, it-security@aurorahealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed POC plan (success criteria, timelines, ownership)

Thanks Paula - perfect. Quick replies inline and a RACI confirmation: 

Telemetry & logs: Redwood can be configured either to ship metrics to your monitoring stack via webhook (preferred) or retain telemetry in Redwood's tenant with a 30-day retention.
- For trial, we recommend metrics exported to your monitoring (we'll provide a Grafana/Prometheus endpoint) and logs scrubbed of any PII on ingestion. Redwood's default ingestion pipeline performs tokenization that removes structured PHI if present, but we need your samples to validate.

RACI (finalized):
- Infra/network: R=Tom Erickson (Aurora), C=Aditya Rao (Redwood SE)
- App integration: R=Paula Ramirez (Aurora), C=Marissa Cole (Redwood AE)
- Security evidence: R=IT Security (Aurora), C=Redwood Security (we will send SOC2 and a short data-flow diagram)
- Procurement: R=Julia Nguyen (Aurora), A=Marissa Cole (Redwood)
- Trial setup & telemetry: R=Aditya Rao (Redwood SE), I=Tom/Paula

Attachments: I've updated the milestone schedule (attached) with Aditya's SE preflight on Tuesday and a proposed kickoff Thursday.

Next steps we will take from Redwood side:
- Marissa will issue a short trial SOW to Julia (target Tue).
- Aditya to run SE preflight (connect with Tom for VPC details).
- Redwood Security to send SOC2 summary + data flow by EOD Wed.

Aditya - can you confirm you'll be free for the preflight on Tuesday at 10am PT and whether you need any AWS account IDs or CIDR ranges ahead of time?

Thanks -

Lauren
